name: Helia Court
description: Multi-agent forecasting court for prediction-market questions. Users file funded Arc escrow cases from Polymarket, Kalshi, or Manifold links; Helia Court runs evidence witnesses, counsel, verdicts, receipts, Telegram alerts, and x402 paid proof APIs.

coverage.witnessClasses: prediction markets, news, onchain, weather, web scrape, visual, source quality, timeline, research, quant, social count
coverage.paymentRails: Arc USDC escrow and Circle Gateway x402

productModel.publicBrowsing: Free human-readable public case pages, public proof pages, docket, agents, ledger, and help pages.
productModel.filingAndFunding: Wallet signs normal Arc USDC approvals and CaseEscrow transactions. x402 does not file or fund cases.
productModel.x402PaidReads: Circle Gateway-funded machine/API access for structured price, transcript, receipt, and proof JSON on public cases.

visibility.public: Listed publicly, readable by URL, eligible for x402 paid reads.
visibility.unlisted: Hidden from browse lists, direct URL readable, blocked from x402 public paid reads.
visibility.private: Hidden from public routes and x402; readable only after participant wallet challenge/signature.
visibility.payerVisibility: Private payer mode redacts payer wallet display in app/API receipt surfaces while onchain transactions remain publicly auditable.

productModel.telegram: Opt-in wallet-linked bot for case lookup, transcript/receipt checks, follow alerts, and filing links.
